kit: Hidden Harbours road floor (road / path kit v4)
rows: every sha256 is over raw RGBA, rows top-down as the PNG stores them
palettes: each chunk's palettes in its own order, five bands each, flat: palette p band b at p * 5 + b

alpha.albedo: 255 where the road covers the pixel (a preview, under albedo/)
alpha.detail: bit d: the texel is its mark's tip toward tipDirections[d] and G.proud > 0.12
